headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs on 4-week rally driven by record FII buying

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Indian stock market extended its 4-week rally as Sensex and Nifty reached 9-month highs due to record FII buying.
Banking and IT stocks supported market recovery during intraday trading on November 20.
Concerns over global AI sell-off and Fed rate hike signals weighed on early trade sentiment earlier in the week.
Crude oil prices remaining at $91 continue to present risk factors for the Indian economy.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs following sustained foreign institutional investor inflows.
Markets recovered from early drops on November 20 with support from banking and IT sectors.
Several companies including Zee Entertainment, Vraj Iron And Steel, and Pashupati Cotspin have corporate actions and dividend dates scheduled.
Gold prices declined to their lowest levels of 2026 amid global market shifts.
summary: The Indian stock market extended its 4-week rally, pushing Sensex and Nifty to 9-month highs backed by record foreign institutional investor buying. On the last trading session, markets recovered during midday trade led by banking and IT stocks despite global headwinds. Investors are watching upcoming corporate actions and dividend stock announcements for the week ahead.
